notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source for the tower itself is the state tower index, which gives a name, county, coordinates and elevation, plus codes (BLL-50649, usgs, gfc-603) that it does not explain; they are not repeated in the story. The index's elevation column is read as feet, which matches the metre value in the record. No build date, builder, staffing, fires or fate was found in two web searches or the cached pages. The National Historic Lookout Register's Georgia list of 29 towers does not include a Forsyth tower. Story is about 110 words, a little under the 120-word target for thin evidence; the rest of the sourced material is county context, so it is not padded further. Georgia Forestry Commission or Monroe County records are the likeliest next source.
